title: In how many countries do women live longer than men?
subtitle: Sort countries by who lives longer there, then see how big the gap is, where it comes from, and the countries where it once ran the other way.
form: cards: sort into two boxes (Women longer / Men longer; all belong in one)
notes: Dialogue, b as the skeptic who is right once (Russia) and asks the India question. OWID/UN WPP 2024: women outlive men in every country in 2023 (world 75.9 vs 70.5); gap 0.6 y Nigeria, 3.1 India/Norway, 5.0 US, 6.1 Japan, 11.8 Russia; 1950 India -1.5 y (men longer until ~1981), also Pakistan, Iran, Bangladesh. Qatar swapped for the USA (thin 1950 data). Review round: two boxes instead of one, cards size 2 arranged side; dashed world-average line; India label -1.5 -> +3.1 at the end. Engine: sort cards drop their flag icons; bar colours only each/same (used same); per-frame 'off-screen' count comes from the parked cards.
